entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Hi Taylor, thanks for making time. This is the recruiter screen for the flight software role, about thirty minutes.

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: Thanks, Casey. Happy to be here.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Before we start: this call is transcribed for my notes. Is that okay with you?

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Great. Tell me about something you built yourself, start to finish.

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: At my last job I wrote the telemetry decoder for our test stand myself. When the timestamps drifted by a few milliseconds per hour, I traced it to the clock on the logging board and fixed it with a resync step.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: How did you know the fix held?

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: I ran it on the bench for three days and compared every frame against a reference recorder. After that I shipped it to the other two test stands.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Who used the decoder day to day?

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: The test technicians did. I sat with them during two campaigns, and they asked for a plain-text summary at the end of each run, so I added one.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: What draws you to this team?

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: I want to work on software that flies, close to the hardware, with the people who test it. That is the part of my job I like most.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Any constraints on location I should pass along?

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: I'd like to stay in Orange County, my kids are in school here.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Understood. What's the best way to reach you?

entries.speaker: Taylor Brightwater
entries.text: Please use my personal email, taylor dot b at example dot net. The other address on my application is an old school account I don't check anymore.

entries.speaker: Casey Lindqvist
entries.text: Got it. Next step: I'll set up the hiring manager screen for Friday and send the invite to that address.
